tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, mp=6 ra_lw=1 ra_sw=1 sf_sfclay=1 sf_surface=1 bl_pbl=1, radt = 30 min) dumped by the instrumented fork ctessum-claude/WRF (module_esm_dump hooks inside SUBROUTINE RRTM after GASABS of phys/module_ra_rrtm.F; dump scm_ref2_1.json). RRTM has no standalone real64 driver, so every expected value is the real32 in-model value and the tolerance contract is rel 1e-5. Inputs are SETCOEF's dumped coefficients (JP, JT, JT1, INDSELF, FAC00..FAC11, FORFAC, SELFFAC, SELFFRAC, LAYTROP, LAYSWTCH, LAYLOW) and the column amounts (COLDRY, COLH2O, COLCO2, COLO3, COLN2O, COLCH4, CO2MULT, WX) of the 103-layer extended column; expected values are TAUG and PFRAC of every g-point and layer, band by band as the flattened per-band fields (g-point fastest), and the quantised table index ITR. The scheme is diagnostic (no time step). Regime: call 1, 19:00 UTC (12:34 LST), first radiation call, clear sky. Tolerances: measured against a NumPy replica built from the same tables, TAUG agrees with the real32 dump to 1.6e-6 relative in every band except band 2 (1.6e-5: the CORR1/CORR2 pressure correction is tabulated at 0.005 steps in real32) and band 9 (4.3e-6), PFRAC to 6e-8 absolute, and ITR exactly except single off-by-one flips where 5000 TFF + 0.5 falls within real32 rounding of an integer. The per-band Linf tolerances are 2e-5 times the band's largest optical depth over the four regimes (band maxima 1.6e4 W/... dimensionless: 15800, 13800, 143, 2360, 137, 0.24, 10.1, 2.0, 278, 600, 1150, 192, 2.6, 2330, 2.8, 0.16), PFRAC Linf abs 1e-6, spot checks at the band's largest optical depth and at layers 40 and 96 rel 2e-5 (with an absolute floor of 1e-3 of the Linf tolerance for near-zero entries), ITR Linf abs 1 (quantisation flips).
